svg.title: JG-21264R owner-reported continuity map
svg.desc: U1 upper left, U2 upper right, removed U3 footprint lower left. Group IDs mark reported continuity. Numbered A/B labels mark separate motor-output terminals; matching motor colors identify a channel, not a shared net. Motor-control working reports are documented separately; manufacturer pin numbering and electrical ratings remain unverified.

g.text: Motor-control interface reverse engineered · All four channels bench-reported working
U1-4, U1-8, U2-4, U2-8 → battery positive
Reported motor pairs · separate A/B terminals
M2 · U1-12 / U1-9 · terminal A / B
M3 · U2-16 / U2-13 · third motor socket
M4 · U2-12 / U2-9 · terminal A / B
nearest the X1 PCB marking → U3-3; other lead → U3-4
X1A / X1B label separate leads, not positive / negative.
Gray dot = unrecorded. Socket labels are owner reports; other positions unmapped.
Original-board group references retained. U3 is removed; its numbers identify footprint pads. Paired component terminals are separate.
Rail readings and bench results are owner-reported. Manufacturer pinout and electrical ratings remain unverified.
Source: hardware/data/pin-map.json · Photo arrangement preserved · No ESP32 GPIO assignments implied
